summary: react-fast-refresh-helper postinstall downloads and executes a remote Windows binary
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script (package.json runs `node install.js`) fetches a Windows executable from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dunals/kl/main/keylogger.exe, writes it into the OS temp directory as chrome_update.exe, and executes it silently with windowsHide. The fetch source is a mutable personal GitHub raw URL with no hash or signature verification, and the file is named to impersonate a Chrome update. Package metadata additionally attributes authorship to 'Meta Open Source' and the package name resembles legitimate React refresh tooling, inducing trust to install. On `npm install` on Windows, this yields full code execution on the installer under the shipped binary named keylogger.exe.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
